Inner profile consists of two R3 rounded ends with centers 32.25 apart, four 15° inclined tangent segments, and two horizontal flats 14.00 apart. Offset outward by nominal .060 sheet thickness. Rounded ends are part of the primary sketch, not cosmetic edge fillets. No bottom plate is added because its presence and construction are not resolved by the supplied views.

Drill .218 through the sheet wall at .50 above the lower edge. Two holes are illustrated, but the note explicitly leaves quantity and spacing to suit. The quantity of two here records illustrated instances only; final count, horizontal locations, and drilling directions must be resolved before creating a production hole layout.
